notes.title: Update 1.2.1.0 on December 14, 2024
notes.notes:
Update 1.2.1.0 on December 14, 2024



1. Archiving can be separated and saved separately.

notes.title: December 7, 2024 1.2.0.9 Update
notes.notes:
December 7, 2024 1.2.0.9 Update

1. There is a problem of chaotic saving after saving too many files.
2. Failure to switch between walking and running.
3. The resolution UI does not display when starting the game.
4. To address the issue of shortcut key conflicts during faster descent, the x key has been changed to increase the descent speed..
5. Terrain editing is still open during construction.
6. Update the flying sword material and add flying sword actions.

notes.title: December 1, 2024 1.2.0.8 Update
notes.notes:
December 1, 2024 1.2.0.8 Update


1. Sword flying instead of jumping, shortcut keys: F： Switch flights.

2. Add editing functions to the terrain, such as building mountains, digging pits, digging holes, leveling the land (note that it is not in the traditional sense, it can be sloped flat), smoothing the terrain, etc. Shortcut keys: Left click to raise terrain, Shift+left click to dig pits, dig holes. T： Switch terrain tools.

notes.title: 1.2.0.7 Update 2024.11.22
notes.notes:
1.2.0.7 Update
1. Improve translation
2. Modify some materials
3. Fix the sticker and it is now usable.
4. Modify the ground to not allow mouse selection to avoid accidental clicking.
5. Add character bounce function, shortcut key F, to quickly drop, shortcut key: Shift+F.
6. The game interface can be completely hidden.
7. Repair the coordinate axis.

notes.title: 1.2.0.5 Update
notes.notes:
Added 6 major categories of plants and some small items.
Fix the following issues:

1. Game crashes caused by weather systems.

2. The issue of shadows in high-quality images.

3. Camera shake issue in first person and reduced speed while walking.

4. Material issues.

5. Remove the basic lighting from the saved file.
